posts.name: jffdougan
posts.cooked:
Citizen Hammer's character card doesn't specify putting the Position card into play, while Sergeant Steel's (and other similar cards) do.

Biomancer's description should arguably be Flesh Molder, not Flesh Moulder. (The former is to shape or mold; the latter is to rot.)

Edit to add: Two extra ones on Greazer's character card.

a) with respect to the card Living Paycheck, it says "put it in play area ...."    (missing the word "the")

b) In his advanced text, the word "themselves" should be "themself"  (singular, not plural).

 

 

I'll add more if/as I catch them while updating the spoiler sheet.
